description: A method whose repeated identical requests have the same intended effect as one request; RFC 9110 lists `PUT`, `DELETE` and the safe methods.
The RFC 9457 JSON error format (`application/problem+json`) with `type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `instance` and optional extension members.
The registration of `IProblemDetailsService`, which makes the exception handler, status code pages and developer exception page write Problem Details bodies.
A singleton, registered with `AddExceptionHandler<T>`, whose `TryHandleAsync` maps an exception to a response and returns `true` when it handled it.
Middleware that gives empty 4xx and 5xx responses, including routing 404s, a body; with `AddProblemDetails` that body is Problem Details.
An `IEndpointFilter` that wraps a specific endpoint or route group, can read its bound arguments and can short-circuit with its own result.
The detailed error page with stack trace and request data, enabled by default only in the `Development` environment.
